searchText: <@!203220829473996800> I think a ban there may have been a bit harsh. A warning probably could have sufficed. I've seen that user spew random comments elsewhere before, we can keep warning them, but it didn't help Happy to publish audit logs btw, aside from banning bots, I think we've banned less than 10 or so in the past year I didn't know they were a repeat offender. I thought those comments were the first of theirs. <@301186049323958275> do you know if the Geth discord is monitored much anymore? Got a question re: freezer dir slowing down sync Posted it there yesterday but doesnt look like much activity going on there in general as of late Sadly, I think there are relatively few Geth experts and they are Geth maintainers and super busy, so not much time available to answer questions. Geth's lack of developer resources is a known and real problem. I'm just about to hit publsh on my EIP-1559 article but I wanted to stick a generic Ethereum graphic on there, just so it shows up more clearly on Medium. Is there are stock of free-to-use graphics somewhere? Are the images in https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website free to use for example? MIT license according to LICENSE file. and that applies equally to images as to code? From stack exchange: "There is nothing in principle that would make the MIT license inapplicable to images, as long as they are subject to copyright." I'm going to take it as a yes I think If you aren't being a dick on the internet with the content, I *doubt* anyone will complain. 😬 that's always the hope...
